metadata.description: A curated collection of skills for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: justinyoo-skills
plugins.description: Install the complete Skills for AI Coding Agents collection.

plugins.name: create-prd
plugins.description: A skill that generates or updates a product requirements document (PRD) from user-provided context through adaptive interviews to fill missing details.

plugins.name: create-tdd
plugins.description: A skill that generates or updates a technical design document (TDD) from a required PRD and TRD through grounded design proposals and adaptive interviews, referencing existing ADRs without automatically creating them.

plugins.name: create-trd
plugins.description: A skill that generates or updates a technical requirements document (TRD) as a PRD companion through adaptive interviews, asking to create a PRD first when one is missing.

plugins.name: localizations
plugins.description: A skill that localizes contents into given locales.

plugins.name: pptx-denote
plugins.description: A skill that allows you to remove all the slide notes in a PowerPoint presentation using the `python-pptx` library.
